text:
lina (partnerships): Heads-up — Datadog + NVIDIA want a joint marketplace demo we can show at the end of Q2. Need to align on observability story for the Dedicated GPU offering. Who's in?

samira (eng-observability): I can own tracing / OTEL wiring and perf dashboards. What's the scope of the demo?

matt (product): Goal: a short (3-5 min) flow that highlights low-latency inference on Dedicated + end-to-end telemetry into Datadog. Also show cost/latency comparisons (quantized vs fp16) and a simple error fallback trace.

toni (solutions): We should prep a reproducible demo env: k8s namespace + small dataset + sample workload that hits KV cache and streaming. Prefer public repo + quickstart.

lina (partnerships): Nvidia wants to show HW telemetry (GPU metrics + MIG) side-by-side with app traces. Datadog wants a dashboard bundle we can publish in the marketplace entry. Timeline: dry run 2 weeks, external review week after.

samira (eng-observability): Proposed tech plan: OTLP from inference runtime -> Datadog Agent (OTLP receiver) + GPU exporter to Datadog. We'll ship a sample otel-collector config. Also create a dashboard JSON and a dashboard snapshot URL for the demo.

ana (devex): Can we make the demo repo include a one-click deploy for both hosted trial and Dedicated eval? e.g., terraform + k8s. Customers should be able to repro.

mat t (product): typo: matt. But yes, one-click is ideal. Lina, can you confirm what NVIDIA will provide?

lina (partnerships): NVIDIA will provide a small reference AMI + MIG-config guide and a couple of synthetic workloads (stable and spike). They'll also help validate GPU-level metrics exporters.

nvidia-eng-bot: Thanks, @lina — we'll hand over exporter config and a Grafana-to-Datadog mapping doc. Expect an initial drop by EOD next Tue.

samira (eng-observability): Draft OTEL collector snippet (for k8s daemonset):
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
      http:
processors:
  batch:
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
      key: "${DATADOG_API_KEY}"
  logging:
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [datadog, logging]
    metrics:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [datadog, logging]
```

samira (eng-observability): GPU exporter example (daemonset): we can use nvidia-dcgm-exporter -> otel-col -> datadog. We'll add MIG labels to traces so GPU metrics are joinable in the dashboard.

toni (solutions): For the demo script, propose steps:
1) Deploy infra (terraform apply)
2) Run baseline workload (fp16) -> record dashboard snapshot
3) Switch model to quantized -> record snapshot
4) Inject a network fault -> show traces/fallback
5) Toggle MIG config -> show GPU metric delta

matt (product): Nice. We also need a short narrative for the marketplace listing: "See latency and cost savings of Redwood Dedicated on NVIDIA GPUs — integrated with Datadog for unified tracing and GPU telemetry." Keep it < 80 chars for headline.

ana (devex): I'll draft a README + one-click button. Also add a small script to fetch the Datadog dashboard by ID so users can import quickly.

samira (eng-observability): Datadog dashboard skeleton (we'll turn into a bundle):
- Latency heatmap (per-model, p50/p95/p99)
- Token throughput by pod
- GPU utilization + memory (per-MIG)
- Error traces waterfall (sample request)
- Cost estimate panel (tokens * model unit cost)

lina (partnerships): Action items:
- @samira: OTEL config + dashboard JSON draft by Thu EOD
- @toni: demo script + terraform by next Mon
- @ana: repo + quickstart + marketplace copy by next Wed
- @lina: sync with NVIDIA & Datadog to confirm external dry run date

samira (eng-observability): Question: do we want to include a short traced example where fallback routes to smaller model when Dedicated capacity is low? That shows our smart routing.

matt (product): Yes — that’s a strong selling point. Keep it simple: show trace with route decision and fallback latency.

nvidia-eng-bot: We'll add a sample MIG config and provide validation steps. Also can provide GPU topology diagrams for the listing if helpful.

datadog-integration: We can prepare a dashboard bundle and a marketplace tile with a prefilled import link. Also have a script to programmatically create the dashboard via API for the dry run.

lina (partnerships): Great — can everyone ack their items in-thread? Need to lock dry run date Fri two weeks from now.

samira (eng-observability): Ack — OTEL + dashboard draft.

toni (solutions): Ack — demo infra + script.

ana (devex): Ack — repo + quickstart + copy.

matt (product): Ack — narrative + fallback scenario.

lina (partnerships): 👍 putting the dry run on calendar for 2026-06-04 10:00 PT. I'll invite Datadog and NVIDIA for the review.

samira (eng-observability): Quick note: for local validation folks can run a small client that simulates streaming tokens:
```bash
# simulate 50 concurrent streams
python examples/stream_client.py --concurrency 50 --model gpt-dedicated --seq-len 256
```

lina (partnerships): Thanks team. I'll post partner contacts + NDA notes in the thread once confirmed. :rocket:
